top_signals.title: India's Cockroach Movement Says It's Politically Neutral
top_signals.summary:
“We are standing with the youth of this country.” Cockroach Janta Party spokesperson Ashutosh Ranka says the movement will raise youth issues regardless of who is in power. He spoke to Bloomberg’s Menaka Doshi.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Majority Leader Thune files cloture on Clarity Act, setting up Sept. 15 Senate vote
top_signals.summary: The Senate is set to vote on the motion on Tuesday, Sept. 15, the day after the body returns, though at least seven non-Republicans will need to support it.
